name: Coup (TextArena, 4 players, 3 gpt-5.6-luna opponents, 40 games)

assignment.task: Official TextArena Coup-v0, 4 players; the three other seats are fixed opponents. Win by being the last player with influence. The request text is the official game transcript for your seat, ending with what you must do now.
assignment.observation: The official TextArena observation for your seat (rules prompt and full public game log).

actions.action: Your reply text; the official env reads the last bracketed command, e.g. [income], [coup 2], [PASS], [BULLSHIT], [block steal captain], [keep Duke Captain].

assignment.evaluation: Win or loss (official rewards); 3 invalid moves in a row are warned, the 4th forfeits all influence (official error allowance).

tool.name: submit_action
tool.description: Submit the reply text for this decision.

contract: One reply text per request, in the format the request asks for.

player.invalidResponses: H0 used structured output (one schema-valid submit_action per response); a refusal or a response without an action was retried with the same request, without a reprompt.

data.note: Shared bundled TextArena @ 1e3160de. Fetch checks files locally; setup installs the shared source in editable mode.
